sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are in outstanding form with seven wins in their last ten matches and sit top of the table with 22 points, while Alsager Town arrive as one of the division's weakest sides, languishing at the bottom with just 4 points from 10 games and having lost four of their last five.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach after a recent draw. The title picture could be affected by third-placed AFC Bridgnorth's home clash against Eccleshall, a fifth-place team also pushing for promotion. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a battle of similarly-ranked mid-table sides, both in reasonable form. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome in-form Wednesfield Community in what should be competitive, while struggling Shawbury United face Barnton at home—Shawbury are on a five-game losing streak despite one recent win. Cheadle Heath Nomads, near the bottom, travel to Market Drayton Town, where both sides need wins to climb away from the relegation zone. Widnes Town, pointless in the league, visit Brereton Social in a fixture between two struggling sides. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a clash between teams toward the lower end of the table, and Sandbach's only real challenger for the title, second-placed Stafford, will hope to profit if the leaders slip.
